root_cause: Immediately after protected merge #4908, some production growth-drain invocations returned HTTP204 with indexedSeen=1, replayed=0, failed=1 and indexedCompleted=0, even though other invocations persisted 2-4 events. Exactly the pre-provider pointer invalid or source missing paths can emit this signature, and break the scan before checking other pending items.
fix: Keep failed/missing indexed pointers durably pending, emit bounded aggregate failure class counts, proceed to other pending entries within the unchanged deadline, reserve stop-on-error for actual provider failures; return HTTP503 rather than false-success 204 if any failure. No deletion, no new scheduler, no exposure of event identities.

evidence.positive: Same production after #4908 other minute runs persisted 2-4 each
evidence.sql: 45 first-party page_view rows created after fix; cohort human attribution still unverified

prevention_rules: A bad queue pointer cannot starve valid work
Preserve source and pointer evidence for reconciliation
Never return green HTTP204 if failed>0
Do not conflate pending queues, receipt persistence, clicks, paid orders
Use exactly existing minute scheduled drain and same provider gates
terminal_rule: Required+CodeQL+Netlify+protected merge and independent per-minute provider readback; any persistent bad pointer must remain a visible blocker until reconciled; no paid revenue inferred.
